control_gap: No data-class retention periods, expiry worker, minimization review, or deletion evidence ledger exists.

evidence.observation: Conversation and safety records have no age-based expiry path.
No TTL index or retention policy is established.
Derived memory lifecycle lacks a general expiry contract.

impact: Highly sensitive records can persist indefinitely, increasing breach impact and privacy harm beyond the original support purpose.
remediation_seed: Define retention by data class, implement enforceable expiry and deletion proofs, and minimize derived health attributes.
reproducibility: Create synthetic records with old timestamps in isolated backends and inspect whether normal lifecycle operations expire them.
root_cause: Archives, summaries, safety state, memories, profiles, and feedback are persisted without repository-evident age-based expiry, retention schedule, or minimization policy.

security_privacy_details.actor_or_failure_source: Data breach, operator over-retention, or abandoned account
security_privacy_details.asset: Conversation, feedback, summaries, memories, inferred safety state
security_privacy_details.sensitive_data_impact: Indefinite exposure of health-related and personal data

title: Sensitive conversation and inferred-state records have no retention or expiry policy
trigger_conditions: Users accumulate conversations and derived mental-health state
Account deletion is not requested or cannot complete

control_gap: There is no conservative quarantine/deletion rule or user-visible disclosure for unattributed records.

evidence.observation: Session deletion coordinates archive and secondary memory cleanup.
Session cleanup depends on provenance and retains records that cannot be attributed safely.

existing_controls: Source message IDs support deletion for attributed memory
Account deletion has a broader forget-user path
impact: A deletion request can succeed while personal or health-related derived data from the session remains retrievable.
remediation_seed: Migrate provenance, quarantine ambiguous legacy records, and make deletion outcomes explicit and verifiable to the user.
reproducibility: In an isolated store, create synthetic legacy/unattributed memory, delete its source session, and query remaining memory.
root_cause: Deletion intentionally preserves records that cannot be attributed to the selected session, including legacy memory without complete provenance.

security_privacy_details.sensitive_data_impact: Residual data after a user-scoped deletion
security_privacy_details.trust_boundary: Deletion API across archive and memory stores

title: Session deletion can leave legacy or unattributed memory
trigger_conditions: Memory created by legacy/unattributed paths contains facts from that session

control_gap: No cross-store transaction, durable deletion job state, compensation plan, or completion receipt spans every store.

evidence.observation: Deletion coordinates multiple stores and can return failure after partial progress.
Archive transaction cannot atomically include separate feedback/memory stores.

impact: The user can be blocked by the tombstone while some data remains, requiring retries or operator recovery and complicating deletion assurance.
remediation_seed: Implement a durable idempotent deletion workflow with per-store checkpoints, retries, observability, and a verifiable completion receipt.
reproducibility: Inject synthetic failures at each deletion step in isolated storage and verify durable job state, retry convergence, and residual records.
root_cause: Account deletion tombstones the principal and then deletes authoritative and secondary records across independently failing stores.
title: Account deletion is a multi-store saga without complete atomic rollback
trigger_conditions: A secondary archive, memory, feedback, or profile delete fails after earlier steps succeed

control_gap: Application-level protection, key separation/rotation, and verified at-rest platform controls are absent from repository evidence.

evidence.observation: Message and safety fields are persisted as ordinary database values.
Mongo documents store ordinary application fields.

existing_controls: Platform controls may exist but are not repository-proven
external_validation_needed: Platform and managed-database encryption, backup, and access controls require independent deployment validation.
impact: Storage compromise can disclose highly sensitive personal and mental-health context in bulk.
non_reproducibility_reason: No live infrastructure or protected database values were inspected; missing repository control evidence supports future risk only.
remediation_seed: Classify sensitive fields, verify infrastructure encryption, add field-level protection where warranted, and establish key rotation/recovery procedures.
reproducibility: Static schema/configuration review only; protected database contents were not opened or reproduced.
root_cause: Conversation text, feedback, summaries, memories, and inferred safety state are stored as readable application fields; repository evidence does not establish field encryption or deployment-volume/database encryption controls.
title: Stored sensitive data lacks application-level encryption
trigger_conditions: Database file, backup, volume, Mongo collection, or operator credential is exposed

control_gap: There is no release-coupled schema version, reversible migration, backup evidence, restore acceptance test, or orphan inventory.

evidence.observation: Schema is managed inline rather than through a versioned migration set.
Indexes are ensured at runtime without a broader migration/rollback contract.
No backup or restore procedure is defined.

impact: Future deployments can fail incompatibly, lose data, or retain orphan sensitive records without a tested recovery path.
non_reproducibility_reason: The failure requires a future schema change or recovery event; the missing controls are repository-proven.
remediation_seed: Adopt versioned reversible migrations, automated backup verification, restore drills, and orphan reconciliation with release gates.
reproducibility: Static repository review; live backup and restore tests are outside the no-external-service boundary.
root_cause: Backends create/upgrade structures in application code, but no versioned migration plan, backup/restore procedure, rollback rehearsal, or orphan-reconciliation job is present.
title: Schema evolution, backup, restore, and orphan cleanup are unsupported by repository evidence
trigger_conditions: A partial migration or deletion leaves orphan records
